horoscopes.horoscope: Your ability to let go things will reflect in your personal as well as your professional life. Today could be a significant day for you, and Ganesha advises you not to forget your special abilities. Make good use of them so that others too can benefit. You will leave your partner ecstatic with the intensity of your love. Your sweetheart will be on cloud nine for your caring and affectionate nature. You will be able to please him/her emotionally. Tonight you are ready to stimulate your lover and passionate love making is on the cards. You will have high energy today. However, you need to keep your ‘fire’ under check. You also need to control anger/aggression, stay composed and convert your energy into something positive by channelizing it. Also, avoid consuming spicy food as it could disturb your stomach. You will be happy to help others and you will not mind helping them financially too. Ganesha suggests you to be sure of financial returns of investments done today. It is better to be calculative then ignorant. Bravo! Your presence of mind will be brilliant today, says Ganesha. Your talent, skill, intelligence will fetch quick progress and will be highly appreciated. Ganesha feels that your brilliance will give a considerable push to your career. It will give you the mental satisfaction.

You will be very sensitive about the image you project socially and professionally. Ganesha sees you treating this very seriously and doing everything you can to make this right impression. Today, you will remain decent, dignified and fosussed in all that you do. Do not be too eager to please others. Focus on your own interests and concerns. Otherwise you could make mistakes and cut a sorry figure. Direct your energies towards meaningful ends. Deep reflection, self analysis will not be out of place. Love life, on the other hand, will blossom. You will want to spend as much time as possible with your beloved. You need to stay attached to your sweetheart even though your daily work seems to be more important today, suggests Ganesha. Even though you do not face any major health issue today you will have to be careful about your confidence. You should depend on your own abilities and avoid seeking moral or emotional support from others as there are chances of disappointment. Ganesha advises you to be extra careful and calculative before taking any financial decision that’s related to commodity or stock market. Gambling must be avoided, else it will turn out to be a bitter experience. Only routine stuff will occupy your mind today. You will be ready to simplify your assignments. Avoid anything that requires more than a casual attention. Try to stay away from complex projects as stars reveal that it would be difficult for you to pay attention to quality.

Routine work bores you, and today you will go all out to break free from the shackles of boredom. The results, however, may not be as dramatic. You will have to depend on your children, if any, to rescue you from the tyranny of routine. Monetary gains can be expected either in the form of inheritance of ancestral property or as increment in your basic salary. You want your freedom today more than anything else. You want to stay detached from your lover Even when your partner comes to you, you are thinking he/she wants to be possessive. Traveling with your sweetheart is on the cards, says Ganesha. Ganesha observes that you shall remain in the pink of health today. Hence, you should apply your mind to tackle tricky people, and utilise your energy to do physically demanding tasks. Also devise a health plan and exercise regularly. Today is going to be an average day for you on the financial front. On this dull day, Ganesha advises you no to take any major monetary decisions, as they are not likely to bear fruit. Today, your creative juices will be overflowing and will add a new dimension to even your routine work. Your creative ideas may fetch appreciation if effectively implemented. You are likely to influence your peers in the meeting or discussion, says Ganesha.

Don’t meddle in others’ affairs today, suggests Ganesha. For they will not take it kindly. Adopt the middle path. Ganesha feels that you must keep your bravado and boldness in check. On the personal front, Ganesha feels that things will take a positive turn and any harsh feelings between you and your beloved will be sorted out. Your self-confidence will be back and you will build a more meaningful relationship. You will feel relaxed and contented in the evening. As far as your physical fitness is concerned, there is hardly anything to worry. However, you may become very emotional today. Hence, Ganesha advises you to control yourself and think practically. To divert your mind – simply do something different and interesting. Today you are likely to have some good financial gains, Ganesha foresees. Your financial strength will be good as the whole cosmos is conspiring in your favour. Your frank and crisp language may help you express better at the workplace. Ganesha, however, suggests that you need to be more articulate while talking to your colleagues and seniors as blunt words may hurt the ego of people and your valuable inputs may get rejected. Avoid imposing your thoughts onto others.

Your pride and self-confidence will help you to excel in whatever task it is that you take up today. Other people will also praise you. You will buy new clothes and other possessions that you have been desiring since a long time, says Ganesha. Shopping is on your mind today and you are in a mood to spruce up in order to catch the immediate attention of your sweetheart. Ganesha feels that you will eventually get support from his/her end and will get closer to your beloved. Regarding your health, the stars are very favourable. As a result, you shall be in a jolly good mood throughout the day. The output you churn out will be on the higher side – surprising one and all, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today you will tend to spend your money on improving your image. Try to control the desire to spend money on unnecessary creature comforts, and try to set aside some money for emergencies. Today, you will be highly creative and motivated. Therefore, use your skills effectively as it is likely to benefit you in your professional growth. You may also be promoted or given additional responsibility at work. Your intelligence and stamina will lead to superlative achievement for the company, feels Ganesha.

You will be faced with serious financial problems today. You may even have to pay through your nose to get what you desire. Later in the evening, you might accomplish some short-term goals. Ganesha predicts that some vital business agreements will end your day in high spirits. You are requested to avoid being overly possessive about your partner as this may lead to disagreement. You cannot impose burdens on your partner. Be ready to listen whatever he/she needs. A clear understanding between you and your sweetheart will smooth the path of relationship, feels Ganesha. Your fitness level may swing downwards on this dull day, says Ganesha. Hence, you need to give more priority to your health. Just avoid working beyond your limits, and think twice before reacting to irritating people and adverse circumstances. Today, Ganesha feels that you may burn a hole in your pocket, and it may take a long time to make up. Though your intention would be to stick to your budget, you will end up overspending. Hard work pays, but at times the payment may get delayed. Ganesha says that you should not lose heart if you don’t get an instant recognition or benefit for the efforts you have put in as patience reaps huge dividends in the long run.

Ganesha says you will be able to improve your relations abroad. There will be good news coming from friends or relatives living abroad. Your working ability and efficiency will make you popular in the office today. In the day today you shall have a variety of good and bad experiences. You have to comply with your beloved’s wish to attend a social function or a film. At the end of the day, you will be patting yourself on the back for making your partner happy. Your partner’s support and social recognition will strengthen your commitment to your lover. On this wonderful day, you shall get up feeling very high. With your mood swinging upwards, you will get along well with everyone in your workplace and home. Right time to get in touch with friends and relatives says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today is a favourable day on the financial front for you. You would be able to generate good income from various quarters. Projects undertaken for government will be beneficial. The strong support from your seniors and your enthusiasm will boost your progress at the workplace. No delay is foreseen on the cards and things will get properly planned and managed. The overall positive atmosphere in the workplace will boost your morale and it will be long lasting.

Be vigilant; keep your eyes and ears open for all the events happening around you, says Ganesha. Your intuition is trying to tell you something, trust it. Think and act positively, the rest would fall in place. You seem to be inconsistent while spending time with your partner recently. You, however, need to get your love life a bit more established and should give your loved one more attention and warmth. A little bit of creativity and honesty will definitely excite you to strengthen your relationship. Regarding your health, the planets are on your side. Thus, you are going to overflow with energy and enthusiasm from morning till evening, observes Ganesha. Work that may be challenging for others, will appear to be easy for you today. Ganesha says that today is the ideal time to make rapid progress on the financial front. You shall get good projects from people in powerful positions. You will be able to increase your contacts base. Since you have been experienced with difficulties before and know how to handle the situation, you will be more prepared than ever to achieve your primary goals. Your focus, commitment, and determination will be well known and ultimately achieve better results for your concern.

Work is likely to keep you on toes. At work place, you and your opinions will be in demand. Those who are associated with stock exchange and shares will be happy to gain profits during the afternoon. Wait and watch the end result in the evening. You want to get faster responses from your loved one but it may not happen in the real life. You need to be practical, feels Ganesha. Therefore, keep patience and control and avoid giving false hopes to your partner, suggests Ganesha. In various spheres of your life, you are bound to taste success today, foretells Ganesha. Your positivity will be spread like wild fire in your surroundings, and people in your professional as well as social circle will thus react positively. Today you will be fortunate in case of financial matters, and therefore you will be willing to push your luck. You will not be averse to taking risks and will also wish to pump money into business. You will be constantly trying to motivate your colleagues at work. Your peers may rely on you. Ganesha, however, advises you to focus on your own work that needs utmost attention. Remember, a little mistake or error will put you in a great trouble, alerts Ganesha.

You have projected yourself as a confused individual, and rightfully so, as the Lions are most of times in double mind. But, today you’ll come up with a specific career plan that will surprise many of the people. Be clear about what you want to do in life, how you want your life to be and make sincere efforts to achieve that stage, guides Ganesha. You need to spend more time with your beloved as it will help you get your focus back. Discussing some interesting topics or engaging in creative activities will entice your lover to get closer to you and spend a wonderful night, suggests Ganesha. The less favourable planetary configuration of today will make you feel less energetic and less enthusiastic, says Ganesha. Just avoid physically and mentally challenging activities and take good care of your health. If required, take a half-day off, and relax. Ganesha feels that today looks like an average day on the financial front, so you must shun taking any major risks. But if you still do so, you are likely to suffer major financial losses. You are undertaking huge responsibilities and have to take an incredible amount of pressure, foresees Ganesha. You may have to work till late at night to fix a problem. It may deviate your focus from more important things and may even spoil your mood, feels Ganesha.

You will take the road to spirituality today and give a miss to materialism. You will visit temples, other religious places, and spiritual leaders to find answers for some of your questions. It will, however, take a while for you to distinguish between mysticism and materialism, and understand that you can have the best of both worlds. Current planetary transit says that you will be in a satisfied mood. It’s a good time to find some innovative ways to decorate your home or revamp domestic activities with your partner. If you are not interested, be ready to get tickled by your sweetheart who wants to sweeten your mood. The stars may be less supportive today, foretells Ganesha. As a result, you may get up from bed feeling low and lazy. Yet, you should try to remain composed. To improve your mood – do something interesting and exciting. Ganesha says that today is a very auspicious day for money matters. You will not be spending much, so things are likely to move smoothly for you on the financial front today. You should not strive for attention at work, advises Ganesha. Ganesha believes that if you keep up the good work that you have been doing, you will get your share of importance by your boss and colleagues. However, you need to take responsibilities for your mistakes.

You will not take matters to heart needlessly today, and will instead calmly evaluate the bitter words of others to see if there is a grain of truth in them somewhere. This is a good practice and one that should be continued. While you won’t be in the mood to tolerate any injustice, you will be able to forgive those who have wronged you and will thus be able to refrain from stoking further, the fires of enmity, says Ganesha. You may feel bored with daily tasks and may want to spend quality time with your loved ones. You are in a mood to take your partner out for an exotic dinner. You are likely to spend the time alone with your soulmate to make him/her feel special and strengthen the relationship. For some reason or other, you are likely to remain tense today, foretells Ganesha. Certain issues in the personal or professional sphere may be the cause of concern. To overcome this adverse situation, avoid being emotional and think practically. Ganesha feels that today expenses are likely to blow up, but you will control things just in time, that is before it is too late. Expenses on routine necessities. will be as usual. Despite all the hard work, you may fall short of your goals. However, don’t let this disappoint you. Ganesha says that you need to maintain and rearrange your office routine. Work harder to achieve your goal and you will surely succeed, inspires Ganesha.
